decision_reason: both decision-bearing blind hazard-frame contrasts exclude zero in PACT's favor

decision_rule.BLIND_UNINFORMATIVE_COLLAPSE: all blind arms are below 10% collision-free success and 5% manipulation success, and the standalone contact benefit is not established
decision_rule.NO_STANDALONE_BENEFIT: the schedule reconciles, the collapse rule does not apply, and either decision-bearing blind contact CI includes zero or reverses
decision_rule.PROXIMITY_STANDALONE_CONTACT_BENEFIT: in blind rows, the pooled 95% instance-cluster bootstrap CI upper bound for PACT-minus-ACT hazard-bar contact frames is below zero and the CI upper bound for PACT-minus-PACT_PERMUTED is below zero
decision_rule.PROXIMITY_STANDALONE_TASK_BENEFIT: the standalone-contact condition holds, the pooled PACT-minus-ACT collision-free-success CI lower bound exceeds zero, and blind PACT manipulation success is at least 5%
decision_rule.priority_clarification: collapse is uninformative only when no contact benefit is measurable; this resolves overlap with the predeclared expected safety-only result

interpretation_scope: inference-time constant RGB is out of distribution for every arm; this isolates retained proximity information but does not claim a blind-trained policy

predeclared_expected_outcome.permitted_claim_if_observed: proximity alone keeps the arm safe but cannot do the task
predeclared_expected_outcome.task_success: collapses for every blind arm because proximity does not localize the cup
